text:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: component=global-rate-proxy severity=high reason=unexpected-throttle-spike schema=rate-limiter-lag
PagerDuty: Incident #PD-9876 paged eng-oncall and infra-oncall at 03:02 UTC
Alex Chang: @channel seeing a big spike in 429s from the global rate proxy, multiple tenants reporting errors. Dashboard shows limiter lagging 40s behind request stream.
Priya Nair: Confirmed, alerting from synthetic tests and customer telemetry. Traffic looks normal, but token-buckets aren't refilling.
Jamie Ops: Any deploys or config changes in the last hour?
Marta SRE: No recent deployments to rate-proxy. CI shows last rollout ~6h ago. Logs show repeated EAGAIN on limiter enqueue and a steady queue depth increase.
Luis Eng: I'm pulling limiter pod logs now. Attaching tail: ```
2026-03-14T03:01:50Z limiter: enqueue failed: timeout
2026-03-14T03:01:51Z limiter: kv-sync delayed: 41000ms
2026-03-14T03:01:52Z quota-proxy: reassigning bucket owner -> drift detected
```
Alex Chang: Looks like the global bucket sync is stalling (kv-sync). Could be etcd or network flaps. Any etcd alerts?
Priya Nair: Monitoring for etcd shows 3 minor outages in the last 10m but leader appears stable. Still investigating network between rate-proxy and kv-store.
Sarah PM: Which customers are impacted? Any enterprise tenants hitting SLAs?
Marta SRE: Quick query: top impacted customers ~ cust-AC and cust-Zulu. Error rate for generation API spiked to 12% for those orgs. Customer-facing pages might be happening.
Jamie Ops: Mitigation plan: 1) Fail open global rate mapping for now (route to local per-region limiter) 2) Increase client-side retry hints 3) Restart one limiter pod at a time to clear stuck state. Thoughts?
Luis Eng: Agreed. We should avoid global fail-open for all traffic; target tenant groups with high error rates first. I'll prepare a config flip: `global_rate_map.enabled=false` scoped to region-us and region-eu for cust-AC and cust-Zulu.
Alex Chang: Patch config ready. Rolling it out to us-east-1 now. Command: ```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/rate-proxy-us-east-1
kubectl apply -f /configs/mitigations/global-failopen-scoped.yaml
```
Priya Nair: Applying scoped fail-open for cust-AC and cust-Zulu in us-east. Patching... done. Observability: 429s dropping for cust-AC within 20s.
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Alex Chang at 03:04 UTC
Jamie Ops: Good. Let's keep that scoped for 30m while we verify kv-sync health. Should we run a diagnostic patch to force a kv-sync and collect heap/threads?
Marta SRE: Yes, collect heap and thread dumps from limiter process before we restart more pods. Also capture packet drops between proxy and kv-store. I'll run tcpdump on the route.
Luis Eng: Heap dump collected for pod limiter-7b9f at 03:05:14 UTC. Uploading to /tmp/heap-limiter-03-05.hprof
Alex Chang: BTW I see token-bucket counters out-of-sync across replicas — suggests a race during leader handoff. Could be a corner-case in the reconciliation loop introduced last year.
Priya Nair: Ops note: we're still seeing intermittent 429s for other customers but <3% overall now. Scoped fail-open brought major customers back.
Sarah PM: Messaging: I'll draft a short update to affected customers and CS. Include that mitigation is in place and we're investigating root cause.
Jamie Ops: Next steps: 1) Keep scoped fail-open 30m 2) Gradual single-pod restarts of limiter to clear stuck in-memory state 3) Postmortem if kv-sync flaps are confirmed 4) Roll temporary telemetry increase to capture more traces for 1h.
Marta SRE: Restarting limiter-7b9f now (graceful). Watch for queue drop and metric reset.
Alex Chang: Restart finished for limiter-7b9f at 03:07:40 UTC. Queue depth back to normal for that replica.
Luis Eng: After restart, limiter reports successful kv-sync and token-buckets resync. No further enqueue errors in that pod.
Priya Nair: Metrics: for cust-AC 429s down to 0.8% over 2m window. For cust-Zulu 429s down to 1.2%. Other customers at baseline.
PagerDuty: Incident escalated to SRE Lead at 03:08 UTC
Jamie Ops: We'll keep the incident open and monitor for 1h. If kv-sync flaps reappear, we'll plan a safe rollback of last reconciliation refactor.
Sarah PM: I've sent customer note to CS and opened a support thread for cust-AC and cust-Zulu.
Marta SRE: Captured network traces show occasional 40ms spikes between proxies and kv-store around the incident window; might be transient cloud routing. Recording as possible contributing factor.
Alex Chang: Agree. Action items assigned: Luis to continue forensic on limiter state, Marta to correlate network events with cloud provider, Priya to coordinate postmortem and communication, Jamie to coordinate runbook updates for scoped fail-open.
Luis Eng: Will dig into race conditions in reconcile loop — I have a local repro attempt running.
Priya Nair: Closing note: Scoped fail-open will be reverted at 04:02 UTC unless we see regressions. Leaving this thread open for updates. :white_check_mark:
Alex Chang: Thanks all — great quick mitigation. I'll keep watching metrics.
PagerDuty: Incident resolved by Alex Chang at 03:59 UTC (status: mitigated).
